title: string (the page title or paper title)
content_type: research_paper | odds_data | injury_report | weather_data | analytics_article | dataset | api_documentation
summary: string (max 500 tokens, concise summary of the extracted content)
key_data_points: array of strings (specific data points extracted, e.g., 'XGBoost accuracy: 92.4%', 'Poisson model calibration: 5% deviation', 'Bills +3.5 odds: -110')
intelligent_equation_extracted: string or null (if the source contains a mathematical equation, formula, or model specification relevant to sports prediction, extract it here in LaTeX format; otherwise null)
raw_text_snippet: string (first 1000 characters of extracted content, stripped of HTML tags)
